test_mp3d_eqa_dataset: test the Matterport3D EQA dataset loading and validate episode count matches expected val split
test_dataset_splitting: test splitting the EQA dataset by scenes into two non-overlapping halves that union to the full set
test_mp3d_eqa_sim: test the EQA simulator environment by stepping through episodes and verifying RGB observation shapes
test_mp3d_eqa_sim_correspondence: test that the agent follows shortest paths and RGB output matches ground truth means
test_eqa_task: test the EQA task by sampling actions then submitting the correct answer and verifying answer accuracy
